StimulusType: Gabor patch (sinusoidal grating in a Gaussian envelope)
Task: 2-AFC orientation discrimination: tilted left or right of vertical

Contrast.Description: Fixed for all trials; difficulty is set by tilt only.

ApertureDiameter.Description: Visible disc around the Gabor, on a uniform grey quad of 19.85 deg.

EccentricityDeg.Description: Head-locked at eye level, straight ahead.

ViewingDistance.Description: Virtual distance of the head-locked quad.

NominalDuration.Description: Intended on-screen time. The measured time of every trial is the duration column of *_events.tsv.

TiltLevels: Per participant and condition from the QUEST+ calibration: EASY (~85 % correct), THR (~75 %), HARD (~65 %). Values in participants.tsv; the tilt of each trial in *_events.tsv.

Display.Description: Interactive Locomotion Lab CAVE (Hofmann 2023, ch. 2): six 65-inch Sony Bravia X85 panels in three columns by two rows, arranged as a half hexagon around the treadmill. The centre column faces along the walking direction; the side columns are rotated by 60 degrees. The upper panels are mounted upside down so the gap between rows is 2 cm. The lower edge of the array is 0.5 m above the belt. From 1.70 m eye height the array covers about 180 x 64 degrees.

ViewingDistanceFrontWall.Description: Approximate distance from the participant to the front wall.

Display.Rendering: One Linux head node runs the experiment and three Windows render nodes draw one panel column each (UniCave, off-axis projection from the tracked head position).

DisplayLatency.Description: The panels' own input lag: the time between the frame on which a stimulus is rendered (the logged onset) and light on the panels. The full chain from a tracked movement to the picture measured 127.0 +- 2.5 ms (pendulum test, Hofmann 2023, App. C; not re-measured for this study).

Apparatus: Treadmill 2.5 x 1.5 m (Ingenieurbüro Achilles) on a Moog 170-140B-2-D-1 six-axis motion platform, which is held level and still in this study. Participants wear a full-body harness on a retracting lifeline.
Source: FollowerPlane component of Assets/ILL-UniCave 1 1.prefab (gaborFrequency 59.6, gaborSigma 0.0353, gaborDiskRadius 0.22, gaborContrast 0.7).
